Artificial intelligence holds incredible promise for our small businesses, but we cannot ignore the real dangers. AI companies need to be held accountable especially when their products put kids at risk, and local communities shouldn’t be left footing the bill for the massive energy infrastructure these corporations require. I’m taking what I heard from our local business leaders today back to Washington to make sure Congress strikes the right balance between supporting economic growth and keeping our families safe.
